text:
julian_sales: Quick kickoff — large healthcare buyer wants a 2-week POC but mandates BYO HSM and "CMK replacement every 30 days". They also want evidence of key deletion after the POC. Need a rapid checklist and rough cost delta for managed gateway.

julian_sales: They're pushing hard on no cloud copies of the CMK and want HSM key generation only. Can we meet that?

rachel_security: Short: yes, with caveats. If their HSM allows local generation and remote ops (PKCS#11/KMIP) we can operate without storing CMK material. If they require repeated exporting/importing of CMKs each 30 days, that increases risk & manual ops — will need a security exception and a detailed runbook.

omar_eng: Technical bits: preferred flow is in-HSM key generation + remote wrap/unwrap calls from our gateway. That avoids key export/import. If they truly want new CMKs every 30d, we can script imports but many commercial HSMs are export-protected. Need to know HSM model and vendor API.

kevin_ops: For a POC gateway in their VPC: recommend 2 vCPU, 4GB RAM min for handshake traffic; bump for throughput. We'll charge a one-time onboarding fee (engineering time) + a small monthly managed gateway fee. I'll get precise bands from pricing.

julian_sales: Can we get a one-paragraph answer we can paste into their security spreadsheet about custody and rotation that doesn't lock us into 30-day CMK swaps?

rachel_security: Proposed pasteable answer: "Customer may retain full custody of the CMK within their FIPS-validated HSM. Redwood supports HSM-backed cryptographic operations via PKCS#11/KMIP and performs envelope encryption: data encrypted with ephemeral data keys (DEKs); DEKs wrapped by the customer CMK. Rotation approaches (DEK rewrap vs. full CMK replacement), frequency, and operational responsibilities are defined in the SOW. Full CMK export/import is supported only where the HSM vendor permits and requires joint runbooks and approval."

julian_sales: Nice. They also want proof of zeroization after POC — what artifacts can we provide?

rachel_security: We can provide: (1) gateway zeroize log signed by our service account, (2) HSM vendor zeroization attestation if customer can run vendor tool and share the signed output, (3) our audit log slice showing last key usage timestamps and deletion event. If they insist on vendor-signed zeroize, they'll need to coordinate with their HSM vendor.

omar_eng: Also recommend we include latency guidance: remote HSM ops add RTT and can increase avg request p99. For interactive workloads test network RTT under expected conditions during POC. We'll include a basic load script.

kevin_ops: On-runbook items for SOW: firewall IP allowlist, operational SSH key(s), service account lifespan, acceptance tests (create key, sign/unwrap, zeroize), and evidence bundle delivery. Onboarding sprints ~4	6 hours eng time.

julian_sales: Pricing question: they asked if BYO-HSM is an enterprise-only feature and what the premium is. Can we commit to numbers here?

kevin_ops: BYO-HSM + managed gateway is an add-on, yes. Typical numbers: one-time onboarding $5k$15k (depending on on-site work), monthly gateway management $300$1,200 depending on throughput & support SLA. I'll confirm exact bands with finance.

ci-bot: POC template checklist created: https://redwood.internal/sales/poc-templates/byo-hsm-checklist (internal link)

julian_sales: Any blockers before I send the questionnaire answers back? I'll flag the 30-day CMK swap and request their HSM model.

rachel_security: Add that we need to review HSM export policy and whether FIPS 140-2/3 L3 attestation is required. If they require CMK export every 30d and their HSM blocks export, we must use in-HSM ops only; this will change the architecture.

omar_eng: I'm available for the customer HSM handshake call. I'll bring the PKCS#11 example and a short test script. Sample pkcs11 command we use in-house: "python3 pkcs11_test.py --module /opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so --pin $PIN --action list" (replace module/PIN). Also health check: "GET /gateway/health" over mTLS.

julian_sales: Great. I'll reply with the suggested questionnaire blurb, attach the checklist link, and note that the 30-day CMK reimport needs security approval and could add latency/ops cost. Will schedule a handshake call. Thanks all.
